title: Hey, It's Me, Souvlakity
statement: The task is the final range (max minus min) of the first player's integers, which he maximizes and the opponent minimizes, when a binary string splits 1..n and players alternately give one integer away for 10^100 turns. Turn pairs keep his count k; for k ≥ 3 he keeps his extremes while the opponent mirrors each gift back, so the answer is the first-to-last-1 span, else k − 1.
